The affine characterisation of ampleness versus very ampleness of powers

standard_prerequisites.name: Relative very ampleness is local on the base

core_obligations: Reduce the remaining direction to finitely many affine opens and assemble using locality (proof lines 9568-9574).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a finite type morphism over a quasi-compact base, relative ampleness is equivalent to very ampleness of some power and to very ampleness of all sufficiently high powers. One implication is trivial, one follows from the very-ample-to-ample result using that finite type morphisms are quasi-compact, and the remaining direction reduces to the affine case by covering the base with finitely many affine opens and using the affine characterisation together with the locality of relative very ampleness.
